items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: You know Bob Williams. He worked with him many a time.

ctx.x: What kind of work, then? Society work? What kind of gigs did he get?

Well, I wouldn't call them Society. It was dances. He played for different groups in clubs and things. Dance music. But he had some good musicians in the band. You know Bob Williams. He worked with him many a time.
